Tips.SourceString: 星绘在面对不听话的患者时还是会露出生气的表情的。
Tips.LocalizedString: Celestia still gets upset when dealing with disobedient patients.

Tips.SourceString: 超弦体是适应了争斗，不断进化并掌握了特殊能力的个体称呼。
Tips.LocalizedString: Superstrings are individuals who are battle-hardened, constantly evolving, and possess special abilities.

Tips.SourceString: 星绘很喜欢咖啡，她希望借由醇厚的芳香此驱赶内心的迷茫。
Tips.LocalizedString: Celestia likes drinking coffee in hopes that its rich aroma will dispel her internal conflict.

Tips.SourceString: 米雪儿是个狂热的游戏玩家，保持着多项游戏的世界纪录。
Tips.LocalizedString: Michele, a dedicated gamer, holds multiple world records across a variety of games.

Tips.SourceString: 奥黛丽经历过崩溃症，但她还是借由周遭他人的帮助和自己的日记，重新拼凑出了自己。
Tips.LocalizedString: Audrey once suffered from Collapse Syndrome, but she still managed to piece herself back together with the help of her diary and the kindness of others.

Tips.SourceString: 拉薇是一个出色的武道家，这和她小时候的经历有关。
Tips.LocalizedString: Lawine is an exceptional martial artist, shaped by her childhood experiences.

Tips.SourceString: 心夏自称保持旺盛精力的秘诀是多多微笑。
Tips.LocalizedString: Kokona claims the secret to staying energized is smiling a lot.

Tips.SourceString: 玛德蕾娜的世界非常简单——创造美妙的艺术，让大家享受这个全新的世界。
Tips.LocalizedString: Maddelena's world is simple—create beautiful art and let everyone enjoy this new realm.

Tips.SourceString: 明瞳孔中的火焰从未熄灭，年幼的她握紧双拳保护弱者，现在的她把枪口对准压迫者。
Tips.LocalizedString: The fire in Ming's eyes has never been extinguished. As a child, she protected the weak with her fists. Nowadays, she points her gun at oppressors.

Tips.SourceString: 如果你还有梦想，去追逐吧，这里能够实现你的一切梦想！
Tips.LocalizedString: Chase your dream if you still have one, for all dreams can be realized right here!

Tips.SourceString: 星绘在面对不听话的患者时还是会露出生气的表情的。
Tips.LocalizedString: Celestia still gets upset when dealing with disobedient patients.

Tips.SourceString: 在夜深人静时，令的脸上总会浮现出一丝温柔。
Tips.LocalizedString: In the dead of night, Reiichi always seems to be kind and gentle.

Tips.SourceString: 白墨最好的朋友送给他一个涂鸦喷漆罐，他用它在真实荒野中一次次留下自己的印记，承载着回忆与自由。
Tips.LocalizedString: Bai Mo has a spray can gifted to him by his best friend. He uses it to leave behind his mark of memories and liberty in the True Wilderness.

Tips.SourceString: 信每天都会被疼痛惊醒，这份疼痛来自于血亲的背叛。
Tips.LocalizedString: Nobunaga wakes up each day in pain, haunted by his kin's betrayal.

Tips.SourceString: “这是从我的灵魂中发出的歌声，也是我想要献给世界的礼物♪”——香奈美。
Tips.LocalizedString: “This is the song of my soul, the gift I would like to offer the world♪” - Kanami

Tips.SourceString: 伊薇特熟悉各种生物，并帮助它们在这个世界存活下去。
Tips.LocalizedString: Yvette is familiar with all sorts of creatures and helps them survive in this world.

Tips.SourceString: 星绘调配的咖啡每天都会加入些许变化，以至于已经迭代了不知道多少个版本。
Tips.LocalizedString: Celestia tweaks her coffee mix daily, to the point where she's lost count of all the variations.

Tips.SourceString: 虽然与你的遭遇只是偶然，但对于星绘来说，这是她值得珍视的必然。
Tips.LocalizedString: Though your encounter was by chance, for Celestia, it was a meaningful inevitability.

Tips.SourceString: 历经无数个夜晚的观测与守候，星空会回应她吗？
Tips.LocalizedString: She has spent countless nights observing and waiting. Will the stars ever respond to her?

Tips.SourceString: 医者不能自医，星绘在治疗他人的时候，也需要一个医生来治疗她。
Tips.LocalizedString: A healer cannot heal herself; Celestia needs a doctor too when she treats others.

Tips.SourceString: 她所点亮的星星，会成为后来者前进的道路。
Tips.LocalizedString: The stars she lights up become the path for those who follow.

Tips.SourceString: 作为星庇所的负责人，她被所有医护人员敬仰，但她依旧保持谦卑善良。
Tips.LocalizedString: As the head of Astral Sanctuary, she is respected by all healthcare workers, yet she remains humble and kind.

Tips.SourceString: 米雪儿最喜欢的生物是猫，虽然暂时还没有养过真正的猫。
Tips.LocalizedString: Michele loves cats, even though she hasn’t had one as a pet yet.

Tips.SourceString: 无数个辗转反侧的夜晚，米雪儿都在问自己，什么才是正义呢？
Tips.LocalizedString: On countless nights, Michele lies awake contemplating the true meaning of justice.

Tips.SourceString: 父亲是米雪儿最好的榜样，是她前进的方向。
Tips.LocalizedString: Michele's father is her greatest role model and the person she aspires to become.

Tips.SourceString: 米雪儿经常因出乎预料的行动而胜利，但也因为违反纪律而经常写检讨。
Tips.LocalizedString: Michele often emerges victorious with unexpected tactics, but she frequently ends up writing self-reflection reports for breaking the rules.

Tips.SourceString: 火力大喵是父亲留给她的伙伴，也是她内心的坚强支柱。
Tips.LocalizedString: Michele's father left her Mighty Meow—a steadfast companion and a strong pillar of support.

Tips.SourceString: 米雪儿不喜欢SOLO，所以她总希望有个伙伴能陪同她一起冒险。
Tips.LocalizedString: Michele isn't fond of going solo. She always hopes for a partner to join her on her adventures.

Tips.SourceString: 奥黛丽身上的王冠，是家族的象征物，坚硬光耀的外表包裹了柔软纯粹的内核，诠释着“家族”的含义。
Tips.LocalizedString: Audrey's crown is a family heirloom and symbol. Its shiny, tough exterior encases a soft, pure core, embodying the essence of family.

Tips.SourceString: 奥黛丽总是喜欢把家族挂在嘴边。
Tips.LocalizedString: Audrey often talks about her family.

Tips.SourceString: 她总能理智地分析形势，冷静面对事态的各种变化，但是被夸奖的时候，她的脸红早已暴露了一切。
Tips.LocalizedString: Though she can analyze situations rationally and stay calm through any change, her blushing reveals everything when she's complimented.

Tips.SourceString: 奥黛丽的火力和她冷彻的头脑是她最大的武器。
Tips.LocalizedString: Audrey's firepower and sharp mind are her greatest weapons.

Tips.SourceString: 重火倾泄的身后，是值得信任的队友，是需要保护的信念。
Tips.LocalizedString: Behind her heavy firepower are trustworthy teammates and a belief that must be protected at all costs.

Tips.SourceString: 奥黛丽作为一个资本家似乎还不够成熟，她仍然拥有着名为慈爱的弱点。
Tips.LocalizedString: Audrey, as a capitalist, still seems a bit immature, holding onto the weakness called compassion.

Tips.SourceString: 拉薇的心思缜密，因此才能成为剪刀手的执行者。
Tips.LocalizedString: Lawine is meticulous and diligent, two contributing factors to her becoming an enforcer of The Scissors.

Tips.SourceString: 拉薇有品茶的爱好，尤其是对绿茶尤其钟爱。
Tips.LocalizedString: Lawine enjoys drinking tea, especially green tea.

Tips.SourceString: 拉薇与冲动的明有着明显的互补关系，在战场上她们能够充分调动队员们的战斗意志。
Tips.LocalizedString: It's obvious that Lawine and the impulsive Ming are complementary to one another. On the battlefield, they inspire their teammates' fighting spirit.

Tips.SourceString: 拉薇曾经是欧泊搜查官中数一数二的好手，本应拥有无限的未来。
Tips.LocalizedString: Formerly one of the top investigators of P.U.S, Lawine had a bright future.

Tips.SourceString: 拉薇握紧手中的脉冲刀，她告诉自己将与过去诀别，那把利刃在黑夜中显露锋芒。
Tips.LocalizedString: Clenching the Pulse Blade, showing its sharp edge in the dark of the night, Lawine tells herself to bid farewell to the past.

Tips.SourceString: 拉薇经常通过武道来砥砺自己的内心，驱散自己的迷茫。
Tips.LocalizedString: Lawine hones her body and mind through budō, dispelling her doubts.

Tips.SourceString: 心夏的房间总是堆满了缺少分类的杂物，前往拜访的时候一定要注意脚下。
Tips.LocalizedString: Kokona's room is always cluttered with random items, so watch your step when visiting.

Tips.SourceString: 在你不知道该点什么外卖的时候，可以问问心夏，她一定有特别的推荐。
Tips.LocalizedString: If you're unsure what takeout to order, ask Kokona—she'll have a special recommendation.

Tips.SourceString: 虽然心夏非常喜爱热闹的场面，但在作战中她更擅长单独行动。
Tips.LocalizedString: Although Kokona enjoys bustling places, she excels in solo operations.

Tips.SourceString: 心夏强大的行动力源自于天生的好奇心，她从不介意品尝一些奇怪的料理。
Tips.LocalizedString: Kokona's strong drive and proactiveness come from her innate curiosity, always open to trying unusual dishes.

Tips.SourceString: 心夏很擅长照顾他人的情绪，却极少让他人照顾自己。
Tips.LocalizedString: Kokona excels at taking care of others emotionally, but she rarely allows herself to be cared for.

Tips.SourceString: 对于玛德蕾娜来说，她的艺术顾问，也是她的最佳模特。
Tips.LocalizedString: To Maddelena, her art consultant is also her best model.

Tips.SourceString: 玛德蕾娜始终信奉着这样一句话，设计师不是在创作，就是行走在取材之路上！
Tips.LocalizedString: Maddelena believes that designers are always either creating or seeking inspiration!

Tips.SourceString: 提到利里这个姓氏，大多数人只能联想到玛德蕾娜的艺术家姐姐。
Tips.LocalizedString: When people hear the name Ms. Leary, they usually think of Maddelena's older sister, a renowned artist.

Tips.SourceString: 如果你也在追寻生活中颇具艺术感的意外与惊奇，请记得联系设计师玛德蕾娜·利里。
Tips.LocalizedString: If you're seeking artistic surprises in life, contact designer Maddelena Leary.

Tips.SourceString: 据说，在世界的各个角落，都能目赌玛德蕾娜取材采风的小小身影。
Tips.LocalizedString: Legend has it that the tiny Maddelena can be seen gathering materials for her art all around the world.

Tips.SourceString: 玛德蕾娜的艺术设计大多诞生于意外或麻烦之中。
Tips.LocalizedString: The majority of Maddelena's designs arise from accidents and troubles.

Tips.SourceString: 伊薇特喜欢喝冰的饮料，吃冰的甜品，但从没有因此感到身体不适过。
Tips.LocalizedString: Yvette prefers cold beverages and desserts, but she has never fallen ill because of them.

Tips.SourceString: 身处人群中，伊薇特总会隐身来逃避可能发生的社交，不得不说，这一套很奏效。
Tips.LocalizedString: In crowds, Yvette goes into stealth to avoid potential social interactions. This tactic seems to be quite effective.

Tips.SourceString: 伊薇特似乎有着不为人知的过往……也许，她在等一个可以倾诉一切的人。
Tips.LocalizedString: Yvette has a mysterious past... Perhaps she is waiting for someone she can open up to.

Tips.SourceString: 在工作中，伊薇特总是冷静而充满理性，似乎没有什么能影响她的情绪……大概？
Tips.LocalizedString: At work, Yvette is always calm and rational, seemingly unaffected by anything...

Tips.SourceString: 经常有同事想要“调用”一段时间菲，不擅长拒绝的伊薇特最终会答应，但在菲离开时，她总是心神不宁。
Tips.LocalizedString: Her colleagues often ask to borrow Fay. A people pleaser, Yvette agrees most of the time. But she always feels uneasy whenever Fay is away.

Tips.SourceString: 伊薇特曾经试着给菲做各种各样的衣服，但都被菲无情地拒绝了，而伊薇特并不打算放弃。
Tips.LocalizedString: Yvette offers to make Fay all kinds of clothes, but Fay refuses every time. Yet, Yvette does not intend to give up.

Tips.SourceString: 香奈美天生就具备了成为偶像的条件，她的容貌、气质和声线，都是顶级的。
Tips.LocalizedString: Kanami was born to be an idol. Her looks, aura, and voice are all top-notch.

Tips.SourceString: 梦想的开始源于香奈美渴望变闪耀的心情。
Tips.LocalizedString: Kanami's dream started from her desire to shine.

Tips.SourceString: 透露一个香奈美的小秘密，她压力大的时候就会在家里泡澡。
Tips.LocalizedString: Here's a secret about Kanami: she takes baths at home when she feels stressed.

Tips.SourceString: 香奈美习惯于隐藏自己真实想法和情绪，希望你能看穿她的脆弱。
Tips.LocalizedString: Kanami tends to hide her thoughts and emotions. She hopes you understand her vulnerability.

Tips.SourceString: 香奈美一直都很想要演唱自己写的一首歌。
Tips.LocalizedString: Kanami has always wanted to sing a song she wrote herself.

Tips.SourceString: 歌曲是对人生的一种记录，香奈美将为那些沉默的、不被看到的人群发声。
Tips.LocalizedString: A song is a record of life. Kanami sings for the silent unseen.

Tips.SourceString: 绯莎喜欢吃味道小、能迅速补充能量的食物，比如巧克力。
Tips.LocalizedString: Fuchsia favors food with a mild flavor that quickly replenishes energy, such as chocolate.

Tips.SourceString: 如果需要的话，绯莎可以将自己的气息完全隐藏起来。
Tips.LocalizedString: Fuchsia is capable of completely hiding her presence when necessary.

Tips.SourceString: 独来独往的绯莎对家庭，既没有概念，也没有执念。
Tips.LocalizedString: The solitary Fuchsia has no concept of or attachment to family.

Tips.SourceString: 虽然看上去身材瘦削，但绯莎的力气比你想象中还要大。
Tips.LocalizedString: While she appears slim, Fuchsia is much stronger than you might think.

Tips.SourceString: 绯莎其实有孩子气的一面，但她自己意识不到，别人也不太敢告诉她……
Tips.LocalizedString: Fuchsia sometimes acts childishly, though she is unaware of it, and others don't dare tell her...
